$comment: The docs contract's kind definitions: the pages each kind of documented software must provide in its documentation root. Read by scripts/contract/check-contract.ts on pull requests, never by the build. A product curates its own pages; how strictly each kind binds its pages to its API is the binding check's (scripts/bindings/).

requiredPages.states: what the package does, and which product is the canonical way to use its capability, linked
how to install the package and what it needs
the platforms or backends it supports
how to use it; a page, or a folder of pages
the API reference: every public export in tables, written by hand and binding `surface`
